created.description: The time when the add-on purchased.

usage_limits.description:
The historical usage limits when the add-on was purchased.
        Possible keys:
        "submission_limit", "asr_seconds_limit", and/or "mt_characters_limit"

total_usage_limits.description:
The total usage limits for this add-on, based on the usage_limits for a single
add-on.

limits_remaining.description: The amount of each of the add-on's individual limits left to use.
